title: Timeline is across the bottom of pages 44–47.

illustrates.quote: Multipage Timelines. (Note: this refers to timelines that appear on more than two consecutive pages.) Insert the timeline at the most appropriate location on the first page it appears. Precede the timeline with a transcriber’s note to indicate the range of pages. Sample:

blocks.text: Timeline is across the bottom of pages 44–47.
blocks.features: Printed as an indented, standalone paragraph.

print.notes: This sample only shows the wording of a transcriber's note; it does not provide the braille translation.

braille.notes: No braille is provided for this sample in the rulebook.

resolution: A left print.blocks/pdfPages empty (print.notes/printFeatures 'TODO') — the same defect pattern as bana-6.8.2c-sample. B's print.blocks/pdfPages are used throughout, verified word-for-word (including the en dash in '44–47') against the PDF page image (p.153, printed 6-9). pdfPages 153 = printed page 6-9 + 144, confirmed by the page footer.
